title: Restocking of Buyer Returns for Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Orders
content:
A buyer return of a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) order received at the Northloop returns center is restocked only when it is graded unopened or opened resellable; any other grade stays out of sellable inventory and is not restocked. A restock never changes fees already billed on the order.

## Grade and outcome

| Grade given at the returns center | Restocked into the seller's sellable inventory |
|---|---|
| unopened | yes |
| opened resellable | yes |
| any other grade | no; the unit stays out of sellable inventory |

## What a restock does and does not do

- A restock returns the units to the seller's inventory for that order and SKU, and is recorded with the date restocked.
- Fees already billed on the order — including its fulfillment fee — are not changed by the restock.

Illustration (hypothetical): two units of one order come back; one is graded unopened and is restocked, the other carries another grade and is not. The order's fulfillment fee stays as billed.
